🆕 New post (Published: August 24, 2026)

Hanno City received a donation from Daito Kentaku Corporation through the Corporate Furusato Nozei (corporate hometown tax) program. The funds will support the Hanno Machina Mirai Vision initiative.

【Donation Amount】
¥1,000,000

【Donation Receipt Date】
March 16, 2026 (Monday)

【Donating Company】
Daito Kentaku Corporation (Headquarters: Minato Ward, Tokyo; Representative Director: Akira Takeuchi)
Founded in 1974. A comprehensive real estate company that handles the full cycle of land utilization planning and proposals, design and construction of rental housing, tenant recruitment, and property management. The company also operates a wide range of services including real estate brokerage, rental management, and energy businesses.

The donation receipt ceremony was held on July 10, 2026.

Source (Japanese): https://www.city.hanno.lg.jp/soshikikarasagasu/tosikensetubu/toshikeikakuka/keikakumachidukuri/14294.html
summary: ℹ️ Daito Kentaku Corporation made a donation to Hanno City
